summary: An LLM gate whose runner's status can't be read is re-evaluated when its time limit passes, so the runner is stopped and the gate fails on time instead of at the next full pass

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay change.

schema.detail: No table, index or migration change.

compatibility.detail: The gate's verdicts are unchanged. While the runner's status read 'indeterminate', nothing marked the gate, so its time limit was enforced only at the reconciler's next full pass.

recovery.detail: An older build enforces the limit at its next full pass.
